elements.name: As Gateway I can receive an update to a job requests from RM for an existing job

steps.name: a TM doesnt have a job with case ID "bd6345af-d706-43d3-a13b-8c549e081a76" in TM
RM sends a create job request with "12345678" "SPG CE" "Unit" "F" "F"
RM sends an update case request for the case
Gateway receives an update message for the case
it will update the job in TM
the updated job is acknowledged by TM

elements.name: As Gateway I will hold a Unit Update request from RM for a job that does not exist when undeliveredAsAddress is false

steps.name: RM sends a unit update case request where undeliveredAsAddress is "false"
the update job should be held

elements.name: As Gateway I can receive an update job request for SPG Unit for an unexisting job and is set to undeliveredAsAddress. gateway will process as a Create message

steps.name: RM sends a unit update case request where undeliveredAsAddress is "true"
Gateway receives an update message for the case
Gateway will reroute it as a create message
Gateway will send a create job to TM
the create job is acknowledged by tm

elements.name: As Gateway I can receive an update to a request from RM for an existing Household job

steps.name: a TM doesnt have a job with case ID "bd6345af-d706-43d3-a13b-8c549e081a76" in TM
RM sends a HH create job request with "12345678" "HH" "E00167164"
RM sends a HH update case request for the case "F" "F"
Gateway receives an update message for the case
is Processed as "HH E & W"
it will update the job in TM
the updated job is acknowledged by TM
an associated a Pause is deleted "F"
